records.name: Navamsa (D9)
records.primary_significator: Marriage, Spouse, Inner Soul, Fortunes after 30
records.calculation_rule: Each sign of 30° is divided into 9 parts of 3°20'.
records.interpretation_logic: If a planet is strong in D1 but debilitated in D9, its positive effects will not manifest. 'D9 is the fruit of the tree (D1)'.

records.name: Dashamsa (D10)
records.calculation_rule: Each sign is divided into 10 parts of 3°.
records.interpretation_logic: Used to check the true strength of the 10th house lord of D1.
